q: When is the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix?
a: The 2026 Belgian Grand Prix runs from 17 to 19 July 2026 at Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps in Belgium. The track is 7.004 km long and sits in the Ardennes hills. It is in the village of Francorchamps, about 50 km south-east of the city of Liège.

q: What is the closest airport to Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps?
a: The nearest airport to the circuit is Liège Airport, which is 65 km away. Maastricht Aachen Airport in the Netherlands is the next closest at 70 km. Both airports give you a good base for reaching the Francorchamps area by hire car or taxi on race weekend.

q: How do I drive to Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps?
a: Take the E40 motorway towards Liège, then switch to the E42 towards Verviers and leave at exit 10 for Francorchamps. From the UK, LeShuttle carries your car from Folkestone to Coquelles, next to Calais, in 35 minutes. The E40 starts at Calais and runs through Brussels and Liège.

q: Can I get to Spa-Francorchamps by public transport?
a: The nearest train station is Verviers-Central. From there, TEC buses 294 and 395 run to the circuit, but they do not run on Sundays. On race weekends, Spa Grand Prix sells City Shuttle coach tickets from Brussels, Liège, Cologne, Maastricht, Lille, and Luxembourg direct to the circuit.
